title: Volcanoes of Italy
intro: 10 volcanoes of Italy, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Mount Amiata
rounds.fact: Mount Amiata is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 1,738 m in the source data. The data places it in Italy.

rounds.name: Ischia
rounds.fact: Ischia is a complex volcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1302. The data places it in Italy.
